body:
This report is about my experience with Anadenanthera peregrina seeds, or Yopo.
Prior drug experiences: I have moderate to extensive experience with a number of psychoactive substances. I've smoked cannabis for about half of my life, starting in my mid teens and smoking daily for about 5 or 6 years. I'm currently not consuming cannabis anymore except for very, very occasionally. Other substances I've done include opiates and opioids (Codeine and Hydromorphone a few times, Tramadol, Tilidine, Fentanyl patches and my favorite, Morphine often over a period of about 3 years), Pregabalin and Gabapentin (wonderful drugs), synthetic cannabinoids, Amphetamine a few times, Ambien once (nightmare drug, steer clear), and a few of psychedelics (Mushrooms, LSD, 2CE, 4-AcO-DMT) and of course alcohol and tobacco.
Background information: I've been dealing with mental health issues, particularly with very extreme depression for most of my life. A lot of my drug use, especially the opiates, were to escape from that. I tried psychedelics for the first time at 19 and fell in love with them, but unfortunately I overdid it and after two very bad trips in particular (one on 3 hits of acid, one on a high but unmeasured dose of 4-AcO-DMT) I became psychotic for several months and didn't touch psychedelics again for years. Last year after some good success in therapy (I was 26 at the time) I decided to give psychedelics a try again and dipped into my old stash of 4-AcO-DMT that I still had left over from years ago. I had a few okay to very good experiences with that, and 1D-LSD over the course of the last year and plan on doing Ayahuasca soon.
Yopo: I had known about Yopo for years but never had a big desire to try it, mainly because I don't like snorting stuff to begin with
I had known about Yopo for years but never had a big desire to try it, mainly because I don't like snorting stuff to begin with
and the thought of snuffing the rather large quantities of seed powder needed turned me off. But curiosity got the better of me and since my 4-AcO-DMT was gone as was the acid, and I didn't have the money or the opportunity to get any more for the time being, I began considering Yopo, just to see what it was like. I had read enough good things about it to think it might be worth trying out. I would say it was worth trying, but it's not at all worth repeating.
I found a place online where I could order 50 seeds for about 10 which was a good deal. So, I ordered them and a few days later they arrived. I had decided at the last minute to try a few other routes of administration before comitting to snorting them. First smoked, then sublingual, and then snorted.
Preparation: Based on the research I had done prior to ordering, I had a good idea of how to prepare the seeds. In a dry, hot pan I placed 4 seeds and waited for them to pop, de-shelled them, ground them up in a mortar and pestle, added some base in the form of baking soda, as that was what I had on hand, adding some water, dying it in short bursts in the microwave, and then grinding it again.
First trial: As I said, at the last minute I shied away from snorting it, so I tried smoking it first. Utter failure, but that was my fault, as I tried smoking the powder in a joint rather than a bong or a pipe since I had neither. The stuff wouldn't burn and even if it did I'm sure I wouldn't have been able to inhale enough to get any effects anyway. Pretty stupid idea but oh well, I honestly went into this whole endeavor fully expecting a few failed attempts so it was no problem.
Second trial: I had read in online forums that some people had had good experiences using the finished powder sublingually so I wanted to try that. If it wasn't evident yet, I REALLY hate snorting things. Smart move to buy yopo then, huh? Whatever. I prepared 4 more seeds using the same method as before and then placed the powder under my tongue and kept it there while trying not to swallow any of the juices. It didn't taste too bad but it wasn't pleasant to have all that powder in my mouth. After about half an hour I had absolutely no effects again.
Third trial: Third time's the charm. At this point I had to admit that if I wanted to experience any effects from this stuff I'd have to bite the bullet and snort it. So this time I prepared 6 seeds, intending to divide the powder and get about 3 seeds worth of powder into each nostril.
It took me a minute of mental preparation but I bent over the plate with the powder and snorted the first huge line into my right nostril and... Holy shit was that agonizing. One of the most uncomfortable feelings ever. If felt like it had filled up my entire right sinus cavity and it burned like hell. Some reports I had read said that the burn was pretty mild, others more or less mirrored my level of discomfort. I had hoped that for me it wouldn't be that bad but unfortunately it was absolutely awful. I tried to get myself to snort the other line but I simply couldn't bring myself to do it. In part because I didn't want to but also because I was unable to move because it was so incredibly uncomfortable.
The burning started to subside after about a minute or so, but that minute dragged and felt like forever. During that first minute I started feeling the pressure on my face that I had read about in so many other trip reports so at least this time it had worked and the pain hadn't been for nothing. I started sweating profusely, and by profusely I mean I was dripping sweat as if someone had turned on a faucet on top of my head.
I had no open eyed visuals but some mild closed eye visuals began. Nothing particularly interesting. Like the first hints of visuals while coming up on mushrooms. I couldn't notice any real cognitive effects, but that may have been because I was so occupied by the discomfort that was in my nose. It had stopped burning but it still felt uncomfortable. I was sitting on my sofa and then laid down, drenching the pillow I was on with sweat. The visuals were still going at the same intensity, nothing was intensifying there.
About 5-10 minutes in I began getting nauseous. I didn't have to vomit yet but wanted to be there just in case. I leaned over the toilet and tried snorting the powder that was still clogging my nose into the back of my throat so I could spit it out. It worked somewhat but it made me vomit. Trying to get all the powder into my throat took a few attempts and each time I vomited. When I felt that it was good enough and I didn't have to vomit anymore, I went back to the sofa. This was around 15 minutes after snorting the line.
While walking back I noticed a bit of pain in my thighs, which was from the vasoconstriction. I never had any problem with vasoconstriction when I was doing psychedelics in my late teens and early twenties, but ever since I started again last year, I seem to have become very sensitive to it to the point that on my last acid trip my legs were killing me for half a day afterwards.
Anyway, as I got back to the sofa, the visuals had subsided completely and all that remained were the uncomfortable physical effects, namely sweating, a very irritated nose, mildly painful vasoconstriction in my legs, and just pure exhaustion honestly, probably partly from the vomiting.
I kept lying on the sofa for half an hour or so and all the other effects gradually went away as well, except for the irritation in my nose.
The next day I woke up feeling like I had a cold. I blew my nose into a tissue and the sputum was yellow. What I had always learned was that yellow sputum = infection, but I have no idea if it's accurate to say that the yopo gave me an infection. Maybe it had to do with the fact that I used baking soda as a base instead something else like calcium hydroxide, and that's what caused the yellow color, which as far as I know comes from elevated white blood cells but what do I know.
I ended up having mild cold symptoms after waking up for about 3 days afterwards. During that whole time my left nostril felt like I had done an absolute boatload of speed all night long. The discomfort in the nose was by far the worst part of the whole experience.
Conclusion: I definitely won't do Anadenanthera peregrina seeds again, at least not by snorting them. The one other route of administration I would potentially try would be rectally, but I'm in no hurry to do it again.
I don't regret trying it, and it was interesting to see what the effects were, but there were simply not enough positive aspects to the experience to make it worth all the nausea, sweating and multi day nose pain.
I'd say it was worth trying.
For me though, it is not at all worth repeating.
